title: Guru Nanak Dev Ji is born
detail: In Rai Bhoi di Talwandi, now Nankana Sahib, Pakistan.

title: The experience at the Bein
detail: At Sultanpur Lodhi, the turning point that began his mission.

title: Guru Angad Dev Ji becomes Guru
detail: Guru Nanak Dev Ji passes the Guruship to Bhai Lehna and dies at Kartarpur.

title: Guru Amar Das Ji becomes Guru
detail: He strengthens langar and organises the growing community.

title: Guru Ram Das Ji becomes Guru
detail: He founds the town of Ramdaspur, later Amritsar.

title: The Adi Granth is installed
detail: Guru Arjan Dev Ji installs the compiled scripture at Harmandir Sahib.

title: Martyrdom of Guru Arjan Dev Ji
detail: In Lahore, under the Mughal emperor Jahangir.

title: Martyrdom of Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji
detail: Executed in Delhi on the orders of Aurangzeb.

title: The Khalsa is founded
detail: Guru Gobind Singh Ji creates the Khalsa at Anandpur on Vaisakhi.

title: Guru Granth Sahib Ji becomes the eternal Guru
detail: Guru Gobind Singh Ji passes the Guruship to the scripture.

title: Execution of Banda Singh Bahadur
detail: After years of campaigns against Mughal rule in Punjab.

title: Ranjit Singh takes Lahore
detail: The start of a unified Sikh state; he is proclaimed Maharaja in 1801.

title: Punjab is annexed by the British
The first Singh Sabha is founded
detail: In Amritsar, beginning a movement of religious and educational revival.

title: The Sikh Gurdwaras Act
detail: Places historic gurdwaras under elected Sikh management.

title: Partition
detail: Punjab is divided between India and Pakistan.

title: Operation Blue Star and the November violence
detail: Events covered in Unit 8 with more than one scholarly view.

title: The Kartarpur Corridor opens
detail: Pilgrims from India can visit Kartarpur without a visa.
